itineraries.title: INDIA: ROYAL RAJASTHAN, PALACES, TIGERS & DESERT CAMPS EXPEDITION
itineraries.tagline: Private palace stays, tiger safaris at dawn, and starlit dinners in the Thar Desert.
highlights: Private palace suites in Udaipur & Jaipur
Dawn tiger safari at Ranthambore
Private chauffeur & expert guide
Luxury desert camp in Jaisalmer
Private lake dinner on a heritage boat
Helicopter transfer between cities
itineraries.description: Seven nights across Rajasthan, designed for travellers who want India at its most regal and unhurried. Wake in lakeside palace suites in Udaipur, trace the pink-hued history of Jaipur with a private historian, and track tigers through Ranthambore's ancient ruins at first light. Evenings end beneath open desert skies, with candlelit dinners and folk musicians playing just for your group. Every detail, from private transfers to behind-the-scenes access, is arranged around the way you want to feel.

itineraries.title: MOROCCO: A LUXURY ADVENTURE IN THE SAHARA DESERT
itineraries.tagline: Marrakech riads, Atlas Mountain passes, palm-fringed oases, and starlit luxury desert camps.
itineraries.bestSeason: March to June | Sept to Nov
highlights: Private sunset camel caravan into the untouched dunes of Erg Chigaga
Opulent stay at Villa des Orangers Marrakech and Dar Ahlam palm oasis
Private guide through the ancient Glaoui Kasbah and Ait Ben Haddou
Stargazing banquet with private chef in nomadic desert encampment
itineraries.description: Versatile and full of intrigue, Morocco perfectly lends itself to all manner of luxury holidays. Extending from snow-capped mountain ranges to rocky hamada and the sweeping sand dunes of the Sahara Desert, there is a lot to explore here. The good news is that our travel experts have found the perfect way to do it. Get off the beaten track and discover a lesser-known side to Morocco as you venture out of Marrakech and into palm-fringed oases and sweeping deserts in this luxurious 10-night adventure.

narrativeSections.title: 24 HOURS IN MARRAKECH
narrativeSections.content: Flying into Marrakech, you’ll spend your first night amid the opulent surrounds of Villa des Orangers, getting to grips with the city on an afternoon private tour of the winding souks and atmospheric Jemaa el Fna square. In the morning, you’ll leave all of this behind as you are met by your private driver-guide who will be at your side for the next eight days of this adventure. Leaving the medina behind, you’ll travel through the heart of the Atlas Mountains, stopping off at the ancient Glaoui kasbah in Telouet, on through the Ounila Valley to the hilltop fortress of Ait Ben Haddou and on through Ouarzazate to the palm-fringed deserts of Skoura.

narrativeSections.title: PALM-FRINGED OASES & DAR AHLAM
narrativeSections.content: Check in at the gorgeous Dar Ahlam before spending the afternoon relaxing by the pool, ahead of a day exploring the 17th-century kasbah of Amerhidil and wandering through the fragrant almond and olive groves. Your private host prepares candlelit culinary discoveries inside private ruined fortresses as lanterns flicker in the evening breeze.

narrativeSections.title: THE VAST SILENCE OF ERG CHIGAGA
narrativeSections.content: Venturing beyond Zagora, the paved world ceases. Cross dramatic moonscape rocky hamadas until reaching the majestic, rolling dunes of Erg Chigaga. Mounted on dromedaries, ascend the crest of the sands for an unforgettable golden hour sunset before entering your bespoke tented oasis with plush silk linens, hot showers, and private campfires under the cosmos.

narrativeSections.title: SANTORINI CALDERA SOLITUDE
narrativeSections.content: Perched high above the sapphire waters of the submerged caldera, your cliffside villa offers panoramic views of world-famous sunsets without the crowds. Enjoy private champagne tastings on your secluded terrace as yachts glide across the Aegean below.

narrativeSections.title: PRIVATE CHARTER ACROSS CYCLADIC WATERS
narrativeSections.content: Board your private Riva yacht for an unhurried exploration of secret sea caves, volcanic hot springs, and uninhabited islets with crystalline waters ideal for swimming and snorkeling.

narrativeSections.content: Stay in a restored 12th-century castle among rolling vineyards. Discover the secrets of Brunello di Montalcino with the head winemaker and enjoy romantic truffle-hunting mornings in private oak forests.
